final: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute - all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE gb_per_minute > all_operator_avg
